scope: The fused score dispatch is in DsaLayer::enqueue_prefill, gated to index_kpool=1, rope_dim=64, index_topk=2048, padded pools>2048, with legacy single-query arithmetic retained. Only full GLM meets this dispatch among the campaign models. Flash uses kpool4/rope0; Qwen, MiMo and DeepSeek do not call this DSA prefill layer. Decode code is unchanged.
